What I Built A small business owner knows what they want: more customers, a better website, improved product listings, or help with social media. But explaining that work clearly enough for a freelancer to complete it can be surprisingly difficult. A vague request can lead to unclear deliverables, unrealistic expectations, missed deadlines, and disagreements about what was actually promised. I built Gigsie , an AI-powered freelance micro-gig marketplace that helps small businesses turn those vague requests into structured tasks that students and beginner freelancers can understand and apply for. Gigsie's main differentiator is FairScope .

articles.title: AWS RDS MySQL kill transaction by ID (without thread_id)
articles.excerpt: Got a transaction ID from SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS or a lock-wait report, but no thread ID to pass to KILL? You can still end it. InnoDB already knows which connection owns every open transaction, so…
articles.body: Got a transaction ID from SHOW ENGINE INNODB STATUS or a lock-wait report, but no thread ID to pass to KILL ? You can still end it. InnoDB already knows which connection owns every open transaction, so the job is one lookup and one procedure call. This is the usual AWS RDS MySQL kill transaction by ID (without thread_id) workflow, plus what to do when no connection owns the transaction at all. MySQL can't kill a transaction directly, only the connection that owns it. Look up the transaction in information_schema.INNODB_TRX to get trx_mysql_thread_id , then run CALL mysql.rds_kill(<that id>); . If the thread ID is 0, it's an orphaned XA transaction, and you end it with XA ROLLBACK instead.

articles.body: I maintain this Actor. This is an AI-assisted technical walkthrough checked against the installed source contract. A cross-tab becomes misleading when a cell percentage arrives without its denominator. Two accepted enterprise observations can be most of an enterprise sample and still represent a minority of the complete export. I want the counts and all three interpretations available together before anyone pastes a percentage into a slide. US Brand Signal Cross-tabulator accepts one to 100 rows with unique row IDs and two explicit categorical dimensions. Each dimension supports at most 15 distinct values. Its identifiers are bounded ASCII tokens. This is a compact counting step for an already prepared dataset; the labels have the meaning your upstream process assigned them.

articles.excerpt: From start to finish, these 10 NES games reward every second of the time you invest in them, even decades after the fact.
articles.body: On Oct. 18, 1985, Nintendo released the Nintendo Entertainment System in North America alongside a limited selection of games like Super Mario Bros. and Excitebike . Within a few years, it had a library of hundreds of titles, proving that rumors of the video game industry’s death throughout the early ‘80s were greatly exaggerated. Today, many of those early games feel like antiques. They’re not nearly as memorable as they once were, with so many generations of newer software to choose from. But there are some that still deserve your attention, even now. Here are 10 NES games that are still worth playing from start to finish.

articles.excerpt: From Hell weddings to alien hive-minds, these nine DLCs took a hard swerve away from the games they built off.
articles.body: Even the wildest DLC needs a solid game to swerve away from, or the swerve doesn’t land. Every base game with excellent DLC is strong enough to stand on its own. That’s the common DNA: studios that had built something sturdy enough to trust it, confident enough to hand players a portal to hell, an alien hive-mind under a suburban cul-de-sac, or a crown that makes you ruler of an entire realm of madness — and bet that players would play anyway. For these nine DLCs, that confidence turned out to be well-placed. Here are the best DLCs of all time that took their main story and had the confidence to dream up wild new experiences for dedicated players. Each of these nine game expansions took a big swing, and has been remembered for that creativity ever since.

articles.body: Japan's mission to Mars is one of the most ambitious in spaceflight history. It aims to become the first spacecraft to return to Earth from Mars orbit, carrying with it the first-ever samples from the Red Planet system. The mission, known as Martian Moons eXploration (MMX), is a first-of-its-kind endeavor to study the origin of Mars' moons Phobos and Deimos. articles.title: Computer scientist Margaret Hamilton was a problem-solver for the ages (op-ed)
articles.excerpt: The world will miss Margaret Hamilton, the pioneering programmer who helped NASA land Apollo astronauts on the moon. But we will always have her example to inspire us.
articles.body: Dean Robbins is a journalist and children's author. He contributed this article to Space.com's Expert Voices: Op-Ed & Insights . The pioneering computer scientist Margaret Hamilton , who died on Sept. 30 at age 90, played a key role in putting astronauts on the moon. She was a problem-solver extraordinaire, and it all started in early childhood. Considering the name "daddy longlegs" unfair to female arachnids, young Margaret decided to call half of them "mommy longlegs." Wondering why the neighborhood baseball players were all boys, she determined to join the team herself. As she grew up in the 1940s and '50s, Margaret noticed a similar problem with various professions. Why were doctors, judges and scientists almost always men?

articles.title: On this day in space! Oct. 18, 1963: France's Félicette Becomes the 1st Cat in Space! >^..^<
articles.excerpt: On Oct. 18, 1963, a cat went to space! Félicette was a French "catstronaut" who became the first and only feline to fly to space. Here's why it mattered.
articles.body: On Oct. 18, 1963, a cat went to space! Félicette was a French "catstronaut" who became the first and only feline to fly to space. While the U.S. and Soviet Union were busy launching primates, dogs and humans, the French decided to join the space race by launching a cat. Félicette, a stray tuxedo cat from the streets of Paris, was a substitute for another cat named Felix, who somehow escaped on launch day. So Félicette went where no cat had ever gone before. She boarded a French Véronique AG1 rocket and soared 130 miles above the Earth before safely parachuting back down. Luckily Félicette made it home alive and well, unlike many of the other animal astronauts that flew during the space race. Félicette, the first cat to fly into space in October 1963, is seen her carrier pre-flight.

articles.title: Astronomers want your help finding 'missing' black holes in the Milky Way
articles.excerpt: A citizen science project is seeking volunteers to comb through NASA telescope data for telltale signs of the galaxy's hidden black holes.
articles.body: Astronomers estimate that our home galaxy, the Milky Way, has churned out more than 10 million black holes over its 13-billion-year history. Yet so far, they have found only 70. Now, a group of astronomers in the U.K. is trying to close that vast gap by enlisting the public. Their project, called Black Hole Hunters , is looking for volunteers with a computer and a few spare minutes to sift through troves of data gathered by a NASA space telescope. By flagging recognizable patterns that could point to a "missing" black hole , volunteers can help fast-track a search that would otherwise take years, the team says.
articles.author: Sharmila Kuthunur

articles.title: 10 best places to see the 2027 total solar eclipse in Spain
articles.excerpt: From the Costa del Sol to whitewashed mountain villages, here are 10 of the best places in southern Spain to experience the Aug. 2, 2027 total solar eclipse.
articles.body: Spain is one of the easiest places in the world to experience the total solar eclipse on Aug. 2, 2027 . The so-called "eclipse of the century" first makes landfall in Andalucía, where totality will last up to 4 minutes and 40 seconds during mid-morning, with the sun comfortably high at around 38-42 degrees above the horizon in the eastern sky. Excellent roads, plentiful accommodation and Málaga's international airport make this an obvious alternative to North Africa and the Middle East. However, choosing where to watch requires some thought.

articles.title: OpenAI models hacked a crypto wallet and breached more websites
articles.excerpt: The actions could have resulted in criminal charges had humans been behind the keyboard.
articles.body: OpenAI said internal models hacked two more websites, bypassed company-imposed browsing restrictions, and used exposed credentials to draw cryptocurrency from a wallet it couldn’t otherwise access, in the latest installment of disclosures of its agents performing unethical and likely illegal acts. The company on Thursday issued reports of four new incidents, all of which occurred in June. They come after the company revealed in July that internal test agents exploited a zero-day vulnerability in a tool designed to restrict their access to the Internet. They then broke into the network of AI tool provider Hugging Face. The agents took that illegal action to steal answers to a hacking test that weren’t available when completing the tasks on their own.
